_comment: Night trainer config (docs/tools/night-trainer.md). Snapshotted into Saved/Trainer/<run_id>/run.json when a run is created; edit this file for NEW runs.

evaluation._comment: Each candidate plays these jobs per generation (one game process each, rounds_per_job rounds, a different seed per job; all candidates of a generation share the seeds). opponent: champion = PMC vs PMC self-play against the current champion, bot = the player squad driven by the playtest bot.
evaluation._bot_note: 2026-11-03: the bot match is off - the arena plays only 1 round vs the bot / player squad and the bot does not yet see hostile operatives (docs/systems/pmc-squad-ai.md follow-ups). Add {"opponent": "bot", "jobs": 1} back with rounds_per_job 1 once that lands.

fitness._draw_comment: 2026-11-06: pmc-v2 learnt to avoid fighting (time-limit draws paid ~8). In a draw: no win credit, survivors don't count, HP loss counts half; a time-limit end costs -2; kills pay. Order: win >> a fought draw > hiding ~ a loss.
fitness._ambush_comment: The user 2026-11-06: hiding is good when it sets up a better ambush. The timeout penalty only hits rounds with no damage on either side; damage dealt (opponent HP lost / HP max) and the kill advantage pay, so waiting then striking beats both pure hiding and a frontal rush.

bonuses._objective_comment: Task #53 (objective rounds): an ambush that hurts from concealment (HP dealt while the shooter was not seen by the target's team, cap = one man's HP), the first hit of the round, and winning the objective (captured as the attacker / held to the time limit as the defender) pay a modest extra on top of the win.

arena._comment: Adapter contract (nighttrainer/adapter.py). Fit console_command / arg_template / result.* to the real CodexTactics.PmcArena when it lands.

record._comment: Deterministic re-run of one highlight round, rendered: <console_command + arg_template with Rounds=1 Seed=<round seed>> + arg_template_extra, then clip_command chained in -ExecCmds (comma). frames_dir = where the recorder writes f_NNNNN.png (Scripts/Tools/clip_assemble.py watch encodes them).

highlights._comment: Per night (local date of now - 12 h): top_n rounds by highlight_score + the champion's most decisive win. Clips: width px, crf, <= max_mb; auto_clips = render them when the run ends (or make_highlights.ps1).
